summary: The Issue #306 implementation conforms to the saved plan: owned_paths now flow through protected diff classification and PR-monitor protected-scope checks, repair prompts explicitly render declared owned protected paths as editable while reserving protected-file approval for unowned paths, GitHub workflow-scope push rejections map to GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SCOPE_REQUIRED with a clear permission message, and comment repair push failures preserve merge-blocking needs_human state with the stored workflow-scope reason for operator notification. Regression coverage was added for owned protected workflow editability, prompt rendering, workflow-scope push detection, and needs_human notification reason handling. Existing validation evidence in plans/ISSUE_306_VALIDATION.md records focused pytest, maintainability, ruff, format, and mypy checks; broad AWF/GitHub validation remains owned by AWF after agent completion.
